item.title: Cameron Man Arrested On California Warrant
item.description: A Cameron man was arrested by State Troopers in Clinton County. Twenty-six-year-old Jakob H. Middleton was arrested on an El Dorado County, California warrants for alleged failure to file a tax return and filing a false tax return. He is held pending the posting of bond.

item.title: Board Re-Appointment Recommendation Approved
item.description: A re-appointment to the Chillicothe Board of Adjustment was approved by the City Council during Monday’s meeting. Mayor Theresa Kelly made the recommendation to re-appoint Adam Brown to serve a second term. The council approved unanimously.

item.title: Chillicothe Alley Project Bids Due Thursday
item.description: A stormwater alley project is nearing the next step. Chillicothe City Administrator Roze Frampton says bids are due on Thursday. For the alley behind KCHI where water gets into many buildings. Frampton says that, depending on the bids and weather, the project could start before the end of the fiscal year on March 31st.
